system.description:
Sense and interface with data systems around you, interpreting signals.

  • Level 1: Access tech in 10 cm radius
  • Level 2: Access tech in 1 m radius
  • Level 3: Access tech in 10 m radius
  • Level 4: Access tech in 100 m radius
  • Level 5: Access tech in 1 km radius
  • Level 6: Access tech in 10 km radius
